feedback: Approved for racing. This candidate is the iteration-5 build (score 160.17, the best raced design) with one change: kp 2.5 to 3.0. Ki is restored to 0.2, because iteration 6 showed that ki 0.3 lowered the score from 160.17 to 139.08 with no gain in progress. Geometry (sensors at y=0.07, x values and weights [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1], sensor_size 0.012), kd 0.4, base_speed 1.0 and line_loss 'last_direction' are unchanged, so the race isolates kp. The reasons for this lever: mean max_error has stayed near 0.060 on every raced track in iterations 4 to 6, and iteration 3 showed that lowering kp from 4.0 to 2.5 did not reduce progress, so kp is a lever that has not yet been tested in the higher direction on the forward-sensor build. Nothing here predicts how the candidate will race. Read the next race as follows. If max_error falls below 0.06 on more seeds and s-bend or slalom progress holds at or above 0.31 and 0.125, keep kp 3.0 and then test base_speed 1.1 while watching max_error. If steering_oscillation on the oval rises clearly above the iteration-5 value of 0.272, or progress drops on the s-bend, return kp to 2.5 and test kd 0.35, as the iteration-6 feedback suggested for overshoot. Survival still comes before speed, so do not raise base_speed while any track ends off track early.
